category_edits.rationale: Scale each causal convolution block's residual update by 0.5 to reduce amplification across six blocks in all four category models. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference remain consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, features, readout, scoring, loss or optimizer.

change_summary: Apply fixed 0.5 residual scaling throughout NextItNet across all four datasets, preserving one checkpoint per category and existing training settings.
